---
title: "matrix_meandering version 00"
output: html_document
---

```{r}
create_game <- function() {
    grid <- matrix(".", nrow = 5, ncol = 5)

    grid[2, 3] <- "#"
    grid[3, 3] <- "#"
    grid[4, 2] <- "#"
    grid[4, 5] <- "X"
    grid[5, 4] <- "T"
    grid[5, 2] <- "T"
    grid[1, 2] <- "T"
    grid[1, 1] <- "@"

    list(
        map = grid,
        player = c(row = 1L, col = 1L),
        treasure_found = 0L,
        game_over = FALSE
    )
}

direction_delta <- function(direction) {
    switch(
        direction,
        up = c(-1L, 0L),
        down = c(1L, 0L),
        left = c(0L, -1L),
        right = c(0L, 1L)
    )
}

print_game <- function(game) {
    cat("\n")
    print(game$map)
    invisible(game)
}

move_player <- function(game, direction) {
    direction <- match.arg(direction, c("up", "down", "left", "right"))

    if (game$game_over) {
        message("Game over. Use reset_game() to play again.")
        return(game)
    }

    delta <- direction_delta(direction)
    new_row <- game$player["row"] + delta[1]
    new_col <- game$player["col"] + delta[2]

    if (new_row < 1L || new_row > nrow(game$map) || new_col < 1L || new_col > ncol(game$map)) {
        message("Blocked! You've hit the edge of the dungeon.")
        return(game)
    }

    target_tile <- game$map[new_row, new_col]
    if (target_tile == "#") {
        message("Blocked by a large rock.")
        return(game)
    }

    old_row <- game$player["row"]
    old_col <- game$player["col"]
    game$map[old_row, old_col] <- "."

    if (target_tile == "T") {
        message("You found TREASURE!")
        game$treasure_found <- game$treasure_found + 1L
    }

    if (target_tile == "X") {
        message("You found the exit!")
        game$game_over <- TRUE
    }

    game$map[new_row, new_col] <- "@"
    game$player <- c(row = new_row, col = new_col)
    game
}

game <- create_game()

move <- function(direction) {
    game <<- move_player(game, direction)
    print_game(game)
}

reset_game <- function() {
    game <<- create_game()
    print_game(game)
}

print_game(game)
```
